title: Pocketwire Advance Late Fee per Period — Tariff Note
content:
When a full late-fee period has closed on the Pocketwire Advance line's most recent advance after its grace period while that advance still has unpaid principal, the late fee of that period is booked on that advance, numbered by the period it belongs to; once no unpaid principal remains, a closing period carries no late fee.

The periods are counted in whole blocks of the tier's late-fee period length in days from the day the grace period ends, which is the tier's grace period in calendar days after the advance's due date, and the period booked is the most recent block that has closed by the handling date. The first full block after the grace period is period 1.

The unpaid principal is the principal disbursed on the line less the part of its repayments and waivers left after all of its booked fees are covered, never below zero.

The late fee of that period is the unpaid principal multiplied by the tier's weekly late-fee percentage, rounded to the cent (half up), raised to the tier's minimum late fee and never more than the tier's late fee cap percentage of the advance's principal less the late fees already booked on the line, that limit being taken to the cent.

## Which period (hypothetical: grace period 7 days, period length 7 days, advance due on day 0)

| Handling date | Days after the due date, less the grace period | Whole blocks closed | Period booked |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 13 | 6 | 0 | None yet |
| Day 14 | 7 | 1 | Period 1 |
| Day 20 | 13 | 1 | Period 1 |
| Day 21 | 14 | 2 | Period 2 |

## Worked late fee (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Standard: 1.25 percent weekly, minimum 1.00, cap 5.00 percent)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Principal of the most recent advance | 200.00 |
| Principal disbursed on the line | 200.00 |
| Fees booked | 10.00 |
| Repayments and waivers | 60.00, of which 50.00 is left after the fees |
| Unpaid principal: 200.00 less 50.00 | 150.00 |
| 150.00 multiplied by 1.25 percent | 1.875, rounded 1.88 |
| Raised to the minimum of 1.00 | 1.88 |
| Limit: 5.00 percent of 200.00, less 0.00 of late fees already booked | 10.00 |
| Late fee of the period | 1.88 |

## The limit at work (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Elite: 0.75 percent weekly, minimum 0.50, cap 3.00 percent)

An advance of 100.00 is wholly unpaid and the line already carries 2.50 of late fees. The rate gives 0.75, which is above the minimum of 0.50; the limit is 3.00 percent of 100.00, that is 3.00, less 2.50, leaving 0.50. The late fee of the period is 0.50.

Once repayments leave no unpaid principal, a period that closes carries no late fee.
